result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out. The main defect is that the selected 'Pizza' filter chip does not match the content below it, which shows ramen and other cuisines. There are also a few minor contrast and consistency issues.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is selected (dark filled), but the content below is not filtered. The 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' sections show poke, burgers, pasta and ramen. The selected state contradicts the results, and the 'All' chip is not highlighted.
issues.suggestion: Apply the selected filter to the lists, or show the 'All' chip as active by default. Make sure the chip state and the results stay in sync.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, the '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' meta line, the search placeholder and the inactive tab labels) is light gray on white or light gray backgrounds and has low contrast. The white time pills over light images, such as '15–25 min' on the poke card, blend into the pale background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1). Add a subtle shadow or border to the overlay pills.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button is styled inconsistently. On the ramen card it is almost invisible against the dark image, and on the pizza card it sits in a semi-transparent dark circle. The white '-20%' and '€0 delivery' badges also vary in visual weight.
issues.suggestion: Give the favorite button a consistent background and contrast on all cards, and standardize the badge styling.

issues.description: The time pill on the first carousel card overlaps the plate image and looks awkwardly placed. The promo banner's decorative circles are clipped at the corner and are a little distracting.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the overlay pills consistently in the card corner with equal padding, and simplify or align the banner decoration.
